Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 11
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread the IMDb release info for Saajan Bina Suhagan. Despite IMDb showing an India 1978 release (and Wikipedia also indicating 1978), the Planner asserted a 1983 U.S. release as the earliest and concluded Taxi zum Klo (1980) was earlier. This incorrect reliance on a later regional date led to a wrong comparison and conclusion.
